# AutoPay Hunter test inbox
# A made-up but realistic phone inbox, May to Nov 2026. "Today" is 15 Nov 2026.
# Formats are modelled on real Indian bank SMS. Names, numbers and IDs are fake.
#
# Block format:
#   @ <yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm> | <sender> | <expected>
#   <body, one or more lines>
#   <blank line>
# expected = CREATED MODIFIED PAUSED RESUMED REVOKED EXPIRED FAILED_SETUP
#            UPCOMING DEBITED DEBIT_FAILED IGNORE SUSPECT
